channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Fluxus-CPGA Prize at Frieze London 2026
item.description: Fluxus Art Projects, with the Comite Professionnel des Galeries d'Art and Frieze London · deadline Closed 28 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 prize, shared between the artist and their gallery. Participation is free of charge.
